info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_IT Management System Deployment Reviews API
info.description: The IT Management System Deployment Reviews API enables users to submit feedback and evaluations for various deployment projects within banking IT management. This endpoint allows stakeholders to capture and report on deployment experiences and outcomes, enhancing project assessments. Typical consumers include IT project managers, banking compliance officers, and deployment teams who seek to improve future project delivery. By leveraging this API, organizations can foster continuous improvement through documented reviews and actionable insights.

post.summary: Create a review for system deployment.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a review for the specified system deployment, identified by its resource ID. Ensure that all required fields are included in your request to successfully create the review.

requestBody.description: The request body for submitting a new review for the specified system deployment. It should adhere to the defined schema and include all necessary fields to ensure proper processing of the review.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing is not yet complete.

reviewScope.description: The scope of the review, which includes the areas or items under review.

items.description: An item or area included in the review scope.

assignedReviewerId.description: The unique identifier of the reviewer assigned to this review.

dueAt.description: The deadline for completing the review.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

correlationId.description: An identifier to correlate requests in different systems.

idempotencyKey.description: A key that ensures the request is processed only once.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the request was made.

sourceApplication.description: The application that initiated the request.

channelId.description: The unique identifier of the channel.

channelType.description: The type of channel (e.g., web, mobile, etc.).
